name: deploy-permission-blast-radius-reporter
description: Reports what each CI/CD pipeline deploy role can actually do in AWS - the effective privilege scope and blast radius of every deploy identity - so teams see where a compromised pipeline could reach. Read-only. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (Agent Toolkit for AWS) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on SAT at 06:00 UTC
